title: Acurite Atomic Clock
text: Acurite Atomic Clock. I purchased a used clock which was a mistake, it works great, but the light on the ceiling is very weak.  Will try it one more night and then decided whether to return or not. Appreciate the atomic setting.

product_metadata.title: AcuRite 13239A1 Atomic Projection Clock with Indoor Temperature Gray, 0.9
features: Projects time on the ceiling or wall in warm red digits
Atomic clock is radio-controlled for split-second accuracy and automatically updates for Daylight Saving Time
Loud alarm clock with snooze button and bright blue momentary backlight
Displays current time, date, day of week, and indoor temperature
Electric-powered with optional battery backup in case of power outage
description: Wake up to the time projected in large digits on your wall or ceiling with the AcuRite Projection Clock. The alarm clock features an easy-to-read screen with time, date, day of week and indoor temperature, a loud alarm clock, snooze button and bright blue momentary backlight. The atomic clock and calendar are radio-controlled to maintain the correct time and date with split-second precision, and automatically adjust for daylight saving time (DST). Features a focus adjustment dial for a crystal clear projection. Projector rotates 180 degrees and includes flip-image feature for versatile viewing angles. Displays indoor temperature in degrees Fahrenheit or Celsius. Includes power adapter. Insert 3 x AA alkaline batteries for backup in the event of a power outage. One-year limited warranty. It's more than accurate, it's AcuRite.
